title: Count Subarrays of Length Three With a Condition
summary: Given an integer array nums, return the count of subarrays of length 3 where the sum of the first and third elements is exactly half of the second element.
statement: Given an integer array nums, return the count of subarrays of length 3 where the sum of the first and third elements is exactly half of the second element.
constraints: Inspect every contiguous subarray of exactly three values.
It qualifies when the middle value equals twice the sum of the first and third values.
Return the number of qualifying subarrays.
reference_solution:
def count_special_length_three_subarrays(nums):
    return sum(nums[i+1]==2*(nums[i]+nums[i+2]) for i in range(len(nums)-2))
hints: Slide a length-three window over nums.
For each start, compute the two endpoint sum.
Compare the middle value with twice that sum.
Summing the Boolean results counts each qualifying window once.
editorial: Summing the Boolean results counts each qualifying window once.

tests.explanation: Only [1,4,1] qualifies because four is twice the endpoint sum two.
The all-zero triple satisfies the equality.
